note: The niche's formats, tiers from research/families.json (20 Nov 2026 scan: 1,230 on-niche titles labelled). demand = hit ids the format rests on; examples = measured views. Tiers: core = families' core; low = in the niche, weaker or crowded (on-niche medians are dragged down by ~12 tiny new channels); avoid = the planner must not pick it.

formats.name: It went wrong: a ride, stunt or amateur build that failed
formats.emotion: 'how did nobody check that?', then relief at understanding the physics
formats.hook: Frame 1 is the moment of failure or one beat before it, in 3D, with a mono caption (date · place · altitude/speed) and the tag '3D reconstruction · not actual footage'; the vehicle or structure named by 2 s; a figure on screen by 5 s; the whole arc told in the first 45 s without the death toll; then the promise of one cause chain; then the title card with a drop to silence.
formats.beats: cold open at the moment it fails (3D, slowed, the part shown, no bodies) -> who built it and why, the confidence -> how it was meant to work (flat diagram, forces) -> the corners cut, each a document or photo -> the day: a clock on screen, instrument rising -> silence, the failure in cutaway, one sub-boom -> the wide shot from far away, the toll stated plainly -> the investigation's finding on the report page, highlighted -> what changed (the rule, the standard) -> cause scorecard
